bull_case: AI/HPC demand, N2 and packaging can extend a multi-year high-return capacity cycle.
bear_case: A demand/cycle reset combined with overseas cost dilution can create large valuation drawdown even without balance-sheet stress.
thesis: TSM has strong business resilience but only moderate price asymmetry at $434.67. Bull upside is meaningful but not exceptional for a $2T+ company, while a cyclical/capex bear case is severe.
counterevidence: Overseas fabs carry structurally higher costs; customer concentration and Taiwan/export-control tail risks remain material.
unknowns: AI/HPC demand duration beyond the current capacity-constrained cycle
falsifiers: A sustained loss of leading-edge share, repeated yield delays, or owner FCF/share stagnation despite rising capex would weaken the thesis.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 현재가격이 비현실적인 Bull Case 이상을 요구
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Current price does not require Bull+.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 파산 또는 영구손실 확률이 기대수익에 비해 지나치게 높음
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Strong net cash and OCF make forced financing/bankruptcy unlikely; geopolitical tail risk is monitored but the exact V9 predicate is not established.
